operation.backup: durable per-file blobs and full v15 boot, modules, DTB tree snapshots, generic Debian links and dpkg metadata before installation
operation.hooks: empty bind mounts on /etc/kernel, /usr/share/kernel and /etc/initramfs/post-update.d only inside private namespace

operation.child_processes: independent session/process group per command; timeout/exception kills full group and reaps before rollback
operation.journal_failure: stdout preserves actual rollback result even if failure.json cannot be saved
